packages.name: SDK
packages.description: Every action by domain, plus the client, batching, utilities and indexers.

items.name: Client
items.summary: Ensforge.create, the action groups, and the read, write and plan option types.

items.name: batch
items.summary: Runs several reads together, in as few round trips as possible.

items.name: Utilities
items.summary: Name, coin type, content hash, duration, fuse, role and error helpers.

items.name: Indexers
items.summary: The indexers, query options and result types of @ensforge/sdk/indexer.

items.name: approval.getDelegate
items.summary: Checks whether a delegate may edit a name's records on its public resolver (isApprovedFor).

items.name: approval.getOperator
items.summary: Checks whether an operator may manage everything an owner holds on an ENS contract (isApprovedForAll).

items.name: approval.getToken
items.summary: Reads the address approved to transfer one ENSv1 name token (getApproved).

items.name: approval.setDelegate
items.summary: Approves or revokes a delegate who may edit a name's records on its public resolver.

items.name: approval.setOperator
items.summary: Approves or revokes an operator for everything the signer holds on an ENS contract (setApprovalForAll).

items.name: approval.setToken
items.summary: Approves one address to transfer one ENSv1 name token, or clears the approval.

items.name: dns.claim
items.summary: Imports a DNS name into ENS with a DNSSEC proof of its _ens TXT record.

items.name: dns.getOffchainResolver
items.summary: Reads the gasless DNS resolver a DNS name sets in an ENS1 TXT record.

items.name: dns.getProof
items.summary: Fetches the DNSSEC proof of a DNS name's _ens TXT record.

items.name: dns.getRecords
items.summary: Reads DNS records and the zonehash a name stores on its resolver.

items.name: dns.getStatus
items.summary: Reads whether a DNS name is imported into ENS, and what it needs to be.

items.name: dns.setRecords
items.summary: Sets DNS records or the zonehash of a name on its public resolver.

items.name: event.decode
items.summary: Normalizes the ENS events in logs or transaction receipts.

items.name: event.get
items.summary: Reads the ENS events of one name over a block range, across ENSv1 and ENSv2.

items.name: event.watch
items.summary: Watches one name's ENS events as new blocks arrive.

items.name: indexer.getEvents
items.summary: Searches indexed ENS events by name, address, resolver, contract or block range.

items.name: indexer.getHistory
items.summary: Reads the full history of a name, or of every name an address is related to.

items.name: indexer.getName
items.summary: Reads one name from the indexer: owner, manager, expiry, resolver, records and protocol.

items.name: indexer.getNamesByExpiry
items.summary: Lists names by when they expire or leave their grace period.

items.name: indexer.getNamesForAddress
items.summary: Lists the names an address owns, manages, holds roles on, resolves to, or used to own.

items.name: indexer.getNamespace
items.summary: Reads what the indexer serves for a namespace: its networks and which features are complete.

items.name: indexer.getPermissions
items.summary: Lists who can do what over a name, a registration, an account or an ENSv2 registry.

items.name: indexer.getPrimaryName
items.summary: Reads an address's primary name from the indexer, verified on-chain when the indexer can.

items.name: indexer.getRecords
items.summary: Reads a name's records and its record inventory from the indexer.

items.name: indexer.getRegistry
items.summary: Reads an ENSv2 registry: the name it serves, its parent registry, when it was created and its counts.

items.name: indexer.getRegistryLabels
items.summary: Lists the labels of an ENSv2 registry, optionally only those an address holds or does not hold.

items.name: indexer.getResolver
items.summary: Reads a resolver and one page of the names bound to it.

items.name: indexer.getResolverLinks
items.summary: Lists the names linked to record sets on an ENSv2 resolver.

items.name: indexer.getResolverRoles
items.summary: Lists the role grants on an ENSv2 resolver.

items.name: indexer.getResolvers
items.summary: Lists the ENSv2 resolvers on which an address holds roles.

items.name: indexer.getStatus
items.summary: Reads the indexer's health and how far each chain is indexed.

items.name: indexer.getSubnames
items.summary: Lists the direct subnames of a name.

items.name: indexer.lookup
items.summary: Reads up to 1,000 names and addresses in one request.

items.name: indexer.search
items.summary: Searches names by text.

items.name: migration.get
items.summary: Reads whether an ENSv1 name can migrate to ENSv2, how, and what it becomes.

items.name: migration.migrate
items.summary: Migrates one or more ENSv1 names to ENSv2, carrying their resolver records and subnames.

items.name: name.get
items.summary: Reads the full state of a name across ENSv1 and ENSv2: where it lives, who owns it, its resolver, expiry and whether it can be registered or renewed.

items.name: name.getLabel
items.summary: Recovers a label from its labelhash through the ENSv2 LabelStore.

items.name: name.getNamespace
items.summary: Finds where a name lives outside ENS's registries: the L2 namespace that holds it (Basenames, Linea Names, Celonames, Durin, Namespace) or the off-chain provider that serves it.

items.name: name.reclaim
items.summary: Resets the ENSv1 registry owner (manager) of an unwrapped .eth name, as its registrant.

items.name: name.setManager
items.summary: Sets the ENSv1 manager (registry owner) of a name.

items.name: name.setTtl
items.summary: Sets the ENSv1 registry TTL of a name.

items.name: name.transfer
items.summary: Sends a name to another account and resolves once the transaction is submitted.

items.name: permission.check
items.summary: Checks whether an account may perform one operation on an ENS name, and lists exactly what it lacks when it may not.

items.name: permission.get
items.summary: Reads what an account may do with an ENS name: transfer it, change its resolver, edit records, create subnames and more, across ENSv1 ownership and ENSv2 roles.

items.name: permission.setRecordAccess
items.summary: Lets another account edit a name's records, or takes that access back.

items.name: plan.get
items.summary: Reads a saved plan and its progress.

items.name: plan.list
items.summary: Lists the saved plans of this client's chain and of its chains, newest first.

items.name: plan.reconcile
items.summary: Records a transaction sent outside ensforge as a plan step's submission.

items.name: plan.resume
items.summary: Continues a saved plan after a failure or a reload.

items.name: plan.send
items.summary: Sends any plan: one prepared by a write's .prepare, or several combined with Plan.merge.

items.name: primaryName.get
items.summary: Reads the primary name of an address (ENSIP-19 reverse resolution), verified against the name's address record.

items.name: primaryName.set
items.summary: Sets or clears the primary name (reverse record) of an address.

items.name: primaryName.signClaim
items.summary: Signs a claim to a primary name on one or more L2s, with one signature and no transaction.

items.name: record.get
items.summary: Reads any mix of a name's records in one request: texts, addresses, content hash, ABI, public key, name record, interface implementers and data records.

items.name: record.getAddress
items.summary: Reads one address record of an ENS name, for Ethereum by default or any coin (ENSIP-9, ENSIP-11).

items.name: record.getAvatar
items.summary: Reads the avatar of an ENS name and resolves it to a URL a browser can load (ENSIP-12).

items.name: record.getContentHash
items.summary: Reads the content hash of an ENS name (ENSIP-7), decoded into its protocol, value and URI.

items.name: record.getText
items.summary: Reads one text record of an ENS name, such as url, avatar or com.twitter.

items.name: record.set
items.summary: Writes records of an ENS name and resolves once the transaction is submitted.

items.name: registration.commit
items.summary: Commits to registering .eth names, the first half of a registration.

items.name: registration.getCommitmentStatus
items.summary: Reads where a registration commitment is in its window.

items.name: registration.getParameters
items.summary: Reads the .eth registration settings: contracts, commitment window, minimum duration, grace period and accepted payment tokens.

items.name: registration.getPrice
items.summary: Quotes the price of registering a .eth name, in an ERC-20 payment token.

items.name: registration.getRenewalPrice
items.summary: Quotes renewing one or more .eth names, in an ERC-20 payment token.

items.name: registration.isAvailable
items.summary: Checks whether a .eth name can be registered now.

items.name: registration.register
items.summary: Registers one or more .eth names: approve, commit, wait, register, then records and primary name.

items.name: registration.renew
items.summary: Renews one or more .eth names, ENSv1 or ENSv2, paying in an ERC-20 token.

items.name: registry.attach
items.summary: Sets or removes the subregistry of an ENSv2 name.

items.name: registry.deploy
items.summary: Deploys an ENSv2 UserRegistry, optionally attaching it as a name's subregistry.

items.name: registry.get
items.summary: Reads an ENSv2 registry: its kind, implementation, parent, canonical name, URI, whether it is emancipated, and whether it can be upgraded.

items.name: registry.setUri
items.summary: Sets the metadata URI of an ENSv2 registry.

items.name: registry.upgrade
items.summary: Upgrades an ENSv2 registry to the deployment's latest implementation.

items.name: resolver.create
items.summary: Deploys an ENSv2 PermissionedResolver, optionally with records, and points a name at it.

items.name: resolver.get
items.summary: Reads the resolver of an ENS name: its address, what kind of resolver it is, who may write to it and which record profiles it supports.

items.name: resolver.getLink
items.summary: Reads which record set an ENS name uses on its PermissionedResolver.

items.name: resolver.link
items.summary: Links an ENS name to the records of another name on the same PermissionedResolver.

items.name: resolver.resolve
items.summary: Calls the resolver of an ENS name with raw calldata through the Universal Resolver (ENSIP-10).

items.name: resolver.set
items.summary: Points an ENS name at a resolver.

items.name: resolver.upgrade
items.summary: Upgrades the PermissionedResolver of an ENS name to a newer implementation.

items.name: role.get
items.summary: Reads the ENSv2 roles an account holds on a name, or at the root of a registry or resolver.

items.name: role.grant
items.summary: Grants ENSv2 roles to an account on a name, or at the root of a registry or resolver.

items.name: role.revoke
items.summary: Revokes ENSv2 roles from an account on a name, or at the root of a registry or resolver.

items.name: subname.create
items.summary: Creates a subname, routed by its parent: an ENSv2 subregistry, the ENSv1 registry or the NameWrapper.

items.name: subname.remove
items.summary: Removes a subname.

items.name: subname.update
items.summary: Changes a subname's owner, resolver or expiry, in one plan, from its parent or as its holder.

items.name: wrapper.getFuses
items.summary: Reads the NameWrapper owner, fuses and expiry of an ENSv1 name.

items.name: wrapper.setChildFuses
items.summary: Burns fuses on, or extends, a wrapped ENSv1 subname as its parent's owner.

items.name: wrapper.setFuses
items.summary: Burns owner-controlled fuses on a wrapped ENSv1 name.

items.name: wrapper.sync
items.summary: Brings the NameWrapper's expiry of wrapped .eth names up to their registration's.

items.name: wrapper.unwrap
items.summary: Unwraps an ENSv1 name from the NameWrapper.

items.name: wrapper.wrap
items.summary: Wraps an ENSv1 name in the NameWrapper.

packages.name: React
packages.description: Hooks, the provider and boundaries, server prefetching and atoms.

items.name: useAddress
items.summary: Reads the address a name points to, for ETH or another coin.

items.name: useAvailability
items.summary: Checks whether a name can be registered now.

items.name: useAvatar
items.summary: Reads a name's avatar as an image URL, with NFT avatars resolved.

items.name: useCreateSubname
items.summary: Creates a subname, optionally with records.

items.name: useEnsforge
items.summary: The client of the nearest EnsforgeProvider.

items.name: useInfiniteRead
items.summary: Reads an indexer list page by page, such as a name's subnames or an account's names.

items.name: useMigrate
items.summary: Moves names from ENSv1 to ENSv2.

items.name: useMigrationStatus
items.summary: Reads whether and how a name can move from ENSv1 to ENSv2.

items.name: useName
items.summary: Reads a name's state: owner, manager, expiry, resolver, registry and wrapper status.

items.name: useNameHistory
items.summary: Lists a name's events (registrations, transfers, record changes), page by page, from the indexer.

items.name: useNamesForAddress
items.summary: Lists the names an address owns, manages or is the primary name of, page by page, from the indexer.

items.name: usePermissions
items.summary: Reads what an account may do with a name.

items.name: usePrepare
items.summary: Plans a write without sending it: its steps, calls and warnings, for a review screen before the wallet prompt.

items.name: usePrimaryName
items.summary: Reads the primary name of an address, verified against its forward address.

items.name: useRead
items.summary: Reads with any ensforge action and keeps the result fresh.

items.name: useReadErrorReset
items.summary: The reset handle of the nearest ReadErrorResetBoundary, or of the whole app without one.

items.name: useReads
items.summary: Runs several reads at once; their RPC calls share the client's multicall batches.

items.name: useRecords
items.summary: Reads any mix of a name's records in one request; the result has exactly the requested fields.

items.name: useRegister
items.summary: Registers names: commit, wait the minimum age, then register, with every step in steps.

items.name: useRegistrationPrice
items.summary: Reads what registering names for a duration costs.

items.name: useRenew
items.summary: Renews names.

items.name: useSetPrimaryName
items.summary: Sets the signer's primary name.

items.name: useSetRecords
items.summary: Sets, changes or clears a name's records in one write.

items.name: useSetResolver
items.summary: Points a name at a resolver.

items.name: useSignClaim
items.summary: Signs a claim to a primary name on L2s, with one signature and no transaction, for primaryName.set on each chain (or a relaying server).

items.name: useSubnames
items.summary: Lists a name's subnames, page by page, from the indexer.

items.name: useSuspenseRead
items.summary: Reads with an action and suspends until the value is there; failures throw to the nearest error boundary.

items.name: useText
items.summary: Reads one text record, such as url, avatar or com.twitter.

items.name: useTransferName
items.summary: Transfers a name to another account.

items.name: useWrite
items.summary: Sends any ensforge write and tracks it.

items.name: Components
items.summary: EnsforgeProvider and the read error and hydration boundaries.

items.name: Server
items.summary: Prefetch reads on the server with @ensforge/react/server.

items.name: Atoms
items.summary: The atom layer of @ensforge/react/atoms that the hooks are built on.

packages.name: HCA
packages.description: Hosted contract account actions and executors (experimental).

items.name: hca.addDeposit
items.summary: Adds ETH to an HCA's ERC-4337 EntryPoint deposit.

items.name: hca.authorizeSession
items.summary: Asks the owner to approve a session key for their HCA, with one signature and no transaction.

items.name: hca.checkSessionCalls
items.summary: Checks calls against the HCA session policy before anything is signed.

items.name: hca.deploy
items.summary: Deploys the signer's HCA through the ENS factory.

items.name: hca.execute
items.summary: Runs calls from the signer's HCA as one atomic execution.

items.name: hca.get
items.summary: Reads an ENS HCA (Hosted Contract Account): its address, owner, implementation, session nonce and verification problems.

items.name: hca.getDeposit
items.summary: Reads an HCA's ERC-4337 EntryPoint deposit, which pays for its UserOperations without a paymaster.

items.name: hca.getSession
items.summary: Checks whether a stored HCA session can still be used.

items.name: hca.getUpgrade
items.summary: Checks whether an HCA may upgrade to an implementation: it must be in the DAO's upgrade set and accept the current implementation.

items.name: hca.predictAddress
items.summary: Computes the address of an owner's ENS HCA, deployed or not.

items.name: hca.revokeSessions
items.summary: Invalidates every session approval of the signer's HCA.

items.name: hca.upgrade
items.summary: Upgrades the signer's HCA to an implementation the DAO's upgrade set and its own canUpgradeFrom check allow.

items.name: hca.verify
items.summary: Checks that an address is a usable ENS HCA of its owner, and returns it.

items.name: hca.withdrawDeposit
items.summary: Withdraws ETH from the signer's HCA EntryPoint deposit.

items.name: hcaAdmin.getGovernance
items.summary: Reads who governs ENS HCAs: the factory owner and whether implementations are approved.

items.name: hcaAdmin.grantUpgradeSetRoles
items.summary: Grants root roles on the HCA upgrade set (role admins only).

items.name: hcaAdmin.renounceGovernance
items.summary: Renounces ownership of the HCA factory, freezing its implementation approvals (factory owner only).

items.name: hcaAdmin.revokeUpgradeSetRoles
items.summary: Revokes root roles on the HCA upgrade set (role admins only).

items.name: hcaAdmin.setDeploymentApproval
items.summary: Approves or revokes an implementation for new HCA deployments (factory owner only).

items.name: hcaAdmin.setUpgradeApproval
items.summary: Approves or revokes an implementation in the HCA upgrade set (role holders only).

items.name: hcaAdmin.transferGovernance
items.summary: Transfers ownership of the HCA factory (factory owner only).

items.name: Executors
items.summary: The HCA route, the executors and their options.

packages.name: Contracts
packages.description: ENS ABIs, addresses per chain, interface IDs and roles.

items.name: ABIs
items.summary: Every ENS contract ABI, by protocol version.

items.name: Deployments
items.summary: Contract addresses per chain and their capability flags.

items.name: Interface IDs
items.summary: ERC-165 interface IDs of registries, resolvers and profiles.

items.name: Roles
items.summary: ENSv2 role bitmaps.

items.name: Entry points
items.summary: What each import path of @ensforge/contracts exports.

packages.name: Errors
packages.description: Every error code by class, with what happened, how to fix it and what to show users.

items.name: CommitmentError
items.summary: A .eth commit-reveal registration step is out of order or out of time.

items.name: ConfigError
items.summary: The ensforge client or a call is configured incorrectly.

items.name: ContractRevertError
items.summary: A contract reverted with an error ensforge does not map to a more specific class.

items.name: DnsError
items.summary: Importing or reading a DNS name failed.

items.name: GatewayError
items.summary: Off-chain resolution (CCIP-Read, ERC-3668) failed.

items.name: IndexerError
items.summary: An indexer request failed, or the indexer cannot serve the query (INDEXER_UNSUPPORTED).

items.name: InsufficientFundsError
items.summary: The account cannot pay for the operation.

items.name: InternalError
items.summary: Something failed that ensforge does not recognise.

items.name: InvalidInputError
items.summary: An argument is invalid.

items.name: MigrationError
items.summary: ENSv1 to ENSv2 migration is blocked for this name.

items.name: NameStateError
items.summary: The name is in the wrong state for this operation (registered, expired, locked, …).

items.name: NetworkError
items.summary: The RPC provider could not be reached or rejected the request.

items.name: NotFoundError
items.summary: Something the call requires does not exist.

items.name: PlanError
items.summary: A prepared or saved plan can no longer be sent as-is.

items.name: TransactionError
items.summary: A submitted transaction failed, conflicted with another, or did not confirm in time.

items.name: UnauthorizedError
items.summary: The account lacks ownership, approval or roles for this change, or the signature that should authorize it is invalid or expired.

items.name: UnsupportedError
items.summary: The operation is not available for this name, resolver, deployment or wallet.

items.name: UserRejectedError
items.summary: The user declined the request in their wallet.

items.name: WalletError
items.summary: The wallet is not in a state to sign: wrong chain or no account.

items.name: HcaError
items.summary: An HCA (Hosted Contract Account) operation failed: the account, its session, an executor (bundler, Rhinestone) or the DAO's upgrade set.

items.name: COMMITMENT_TOO_NEW
items.summary: The registration commitment is not ready yet.

items.name: COMMITMENT_TOO_OLD
items.summary: The registration commitment has expired.

items.name: COMMITMENT_EXISTS
items.summary: An unexpired commitment with the same data already exists.

items.name: COMMITMENT_NOT_FOUND
items.summary: No commitment was found for this registration.

items.name: UNKNOWN_CHAIN
items.summary: ensforge has no ENS deployment for this chain.

items.name: INVALID_DEPLOYMENT
items.summary: The deployment profile is invalid.

items.name: CONTRACT_NOT_DEPLOYED
items.summary: No contract is deployed at the called address.

items.name: WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED
items.summary: This action needs a wallet client with an account.

items.name: INDEXER_NOT_CONFIGURED
items.summary: This action needs an indexer.

items.name: CCIP_READ_DISABLED
items.summary: This name resolves off-chain, and CCIP-Read is disabled.

items.name: INVALID_ACTION_GROUP
items.summary: A decorator added an action group with a reserved name.

items.name: CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED
items.summary: The client cannot reach chain ?.

items.name: CONTRACT_REVERTED
items.summary: The contract call reverted.

items.name: DNS_RECORD_MISSING
items.summary: The _ens TXT record is missing.

items.name: DNSSEC_PROOF_FAILED
items.summary: The DNSSEC proof could not be built or verified.

items.name: PROOF_STALE
items.summary: The DNSSEC proof is older than the one on-chain.

items.name: TLD_NOT_PUBLIC
items.summary: The top-level domain is not a public suffix and cannot be imported.

items.name: GATEWAY_REQUEST_FAILED
items.summary: The off-chain gateway request failed.

items.name: GATEWAY_RESPONSE_INVALID
items.summary: The off-chain gateway returned an invalid response.

items.name: OFFCHAIN_LOOKUP_INVALID
items.summary: The resolver requested an off-chain lookup from an unexpected sender.

items.name: INDEXER_UNAVAILABLE
items.summary: The indexer is unavailable.

items.name: INDEXER_RATE_LIMITED
items.summary: The indexer is rate limiting requests.

items.name: INDEXER_RESPONSE_INVALID
items.summary: The indexer returned an unexpected response.

items.name: INDEXER_REQUEST_REJECTED
items.summary: The indexer rejected the request.

items.name: INDEXER_BEHIND
items.summary: The indexer is behind the chain.

items.name: INDEXER_UNSUPPORTED
items.summary: The indexer does not support this query.

items.name: INSUFFICIENT_ETH
items.summary: The account does not have enough ETH.

items.name: INSUFFICIENT_TOKEN_BALANCE
items.summary: The account does not have enough of the payment token.

items.name: UNEXPECTED
items.summary: An unexpected error occurred.

items.name: INVALID_NAME
items.summary: undefined is not a valid ENS name.

items.name: INVALID_ADDRESS
items.summary: undefined is not a valid address.

items.name: INVALID_COIN_TYPE
items.summary: undefined is not a known coin type.

items.name: INVALID_CONTENT_HASH
items.summary: undefined is not a valid content hash.

items.name: INVALID_RECORD_VALUE
items.summary: undefined is not a valid record value.

items.name: INVALID_DURATION
items.summary: undefined is not a valid duration.

items.name: DURATION_TOO_SHORT
items.summary: The duration is shorter than the registrar's minimum.

items.name: INVALID_EXPIRY
items.summary: The expiry cannot be in the past or earlier than the current expiry.

items.name: INVALID_ROLES
items.summary: undefined is not a valid role bitmap.

items.name: SALT_TAKEN
items.summary: A contract was already deployed with this salt.

items.name: NOT_ELIGIBLE
items.summary: The name cannot be migrated to ENSv2 yet.

items.name: ALREADY_MIGRATED
items.summary: The name is already on ENSv2.

items.name: NAME_NOT_LOCKED
items.summary: The wrapped name is not locked, so it cannot use the locked migration route.

items.name: RECORDS_UNKNOWN
items.summary: The name's records are not known, so they cannot be copied to its new resolver.

items.name: VERIFICATION_FAILED
items.summary: The migration was sent, but the name's ENSv2 state differs from the plan.

items.name: NAME_NOT_AVAILABLE
items.summary: The name is already registered.

items.name: NAME_NOT_REGISTERED
items.summary: The name is not registered.

items.name: NAME_EXTERNAL
items.summary: The name is not in ENS's registries: its parent's resolver serves it.

items.name: NAME_RESERVED
items.summary: The name is reserved.

items.name: NAME_EXPIRED
items.summary: The name has expired.

items.name: NAME_NOT_RENEWABLE
items.summary: The name cannot be renewed.

items.name: NAME_ALREADY_RENEWED
items.summary: Every name already expires at or after until.

items.name: NAME_LOCKED
items.summary: The name is locked.

items.name: NAME_NOT_WRAPPED
items.summary: The name is not wrapped in the NameWrapper.

items.name: NAME_WRAPPED
items.summary: The name is already wrapped in the NameWrapper.

items.name: NAME_HAS_SUBNAMES
items.summary: The name has subnames, which would keep resolving without it.

items.name: NAME_UNREACHABLE
items.summary: ENSv2 resolution no longer reaches this ENSv1 name.

items.name: NAME_REQUIRES_MIGRATION
items.summary: The name must be migrated to ENSv2 first.

items.name: PARENT_NOT_MIGRATED
items.summary: The parent name has not been migrated to ENSv2.

items.name: REGISTRY_NOT_EMANCIPATED
items.summary: The registry is not emancipated, so this transfer is unsafe.

items.name: SUBREGISTRY_EXISTS
items.summary: The name already has a subregistry; replacing it orphans every subname in it.

items.name: RPC_REQUEST_FAILED
items.summary: The RPC request failed.

items.name: RPC_TIMEOUT
items.summary: The RPC request timed out.

items.name: RATE_LIMITED
items.summary: The RPC provider is rate limiting requests.

items.name: LOG_RANGE_TOO_LARGE
items.summary: The RPC provider's eth_getLogs limits make this block range too expensive.

items.name: RESOLVER_NOT_FOUND
items.summary: The name has no resolver.

items.name: RESOLVER_NOT_DEPLOYED
items.summary: No contract is deployed at the resolver address.

items.name: RECORD_NOT_FOUND
items.summary: The record is not set.

items.name: PRIMARY_NAME_NOT_SET
items.summary: The address has no primary name.
